literal: He who is confused true reality having seen like that indeed if examined he who lacks compassion doing virtue.
translation: If examined, the virtue practiced by one who lacks compassion is like a confused mind perceiving true reality.
modern: ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்தால், இரக்கம் இல்லாதவன் செய்யும் அறச்செயல்கள், மனத்தெளிவு இல்லாதவன் உண்மையான பொருளைக் கண்டதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet compares a person without compassion trying to practice virtue to a confused person trying to grasp the ultimate truth. Just as a clouded mind cannot truly perceive reality, a heart without compassion cannot genuinely perform virtuous deeds. The word 'தெருளாதான்' (one lacking mental clarity) perfectly mirrors 'அருளாதான்' (one lacking emotional grace), showing that compassion is the fundamental clarity of the heart.
